extName.message: YTM AI Filter — skip AI music on YouTube Music

extDescription.message: Skips, dislikes or blocks tracks that YouTube Music labels as AI-generated. You choose which labels and actions.

toggleFilter.message: Turn the filter on or off

tagline.message: Skips tracks with an AI label on music.youtube.com

labelsDesc.message: YouTube Music shows a label in the player. Choose which ones the extension reacts to.

labelFullDesc.message: The whole track is generated: music and vocals.

labelPartlyDesc.message: AI made part of the track, e.g. vocals. Real artists can be here too.

actionsTitle.message: What to do with such a track

actionsDesc.message: Actions run as soon as the label appears in the player.

actSkipDesc.message: Jump to the next one right away.

actDislikeDesc.message: A signal to recommendations; also affects your phone. Needs you to be signed in.

actAutoBlock.message: Add the artist to the blocklist

actAutoBlockDesc.message: Their next tracks are skipped before the label even appears.

actSkipBlockedDesc.message: Even when the track has no label.

actToastDesc.message: A small message on the page with an Undo button.

delayDesc.message: Time to press Undo in the notification

blocklistDesc.message: Tracks by these artists are skipped right away, even without a label.

whitelistDesc.message: The extension never touches these artists, even with a label.

advancedDesc.message: The exact label text the extension looks for, one per line. Add your language's version if YouTube Music shows labels translated.

dataDesc.message: Settings sync across your Chrome browsers.

importFail.message: This file isn't a YTM AI Filter export.

confirmResetAll.message: Reset all settings, blocklist and whitelist?
